title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration) shard fails with generic exit code 1, unrelated to PR changes
test_name: Aspire dynamic debug configuration E2E "after each" hook for "does not launch an AppHost when the ambiguous AppHost picker is dismissed"
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
error_pattern: Process completed with exit code 1. Dynamic debug configuration E2E teardown failed with EBUSY: resource busy or locked, rmdir 'C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\aev-*\workspace\.e2e-dynamic-debug\ambiguous' at runE2eTeardown (fixtures.js:217:15).
analysis: Test teardown fails on Windows with EBUSY resource busy/locked while removing a temp workspace directory. This is a Windows file-locking race condition during E2E cleanup, unrelated to the PR which only modifies Aspire.Dashboard Razor/CSS/test files. This exact shard and error signature has recurred 27 times previously.
